title: Berry picking lesson with patience

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: These bright berries look easy, but we should pick them slowly!

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: Rushing might make them roll away, so let’s be careful!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Okay, I’ll think first before grabbing each tasty berry!

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: Patience is like a gentle river guiding berries safely onward!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: I’ll move slowly, and together we’ll catch every berry!

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: Watch how the meadow smiles when we act gently!
